case_title: SHAMIEH, ELIAS VS BANK OF AMERICA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,000.00 FILED BY SHAMIEH, ELIAS AS TO DEFENDANT BANK OF AMERICA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-22-1994 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 03
